attrs.evidence: L-ID-1 (kernel-side: header == constant == certificate generator); grid_check v2.5 (engine-free: KERNEL_VERSION and WORLD_VERSION parsed from source, each locked to artifact_versions). Supersedes @1, whose single-artifact lockstep round 7 outgrew.
attrs.statement: No executable may disagree with its artifact identity, and the RECORD may not disagree with any of them: every shipped executable declares a version constant; the grid carries artifact_versions, a map from artifact to declared version; grid_check parses each constant from source and locks the map. grid.version is the RECORD's own lineage version, decoupled from any single artifact.
